label: Half Marathon
short_description: Road races offering the 21.1km half marathon distance across Southeast Asia.
intro: The half marathon, at 21.1 kilometers, is one of the most popular race distances for runners moving up from 10K events or building toward a first full marathon. Southeast Asia's calendar includes half marathons as standalone events and as one of several distances offered at larger multi-race festivals.

faqs.question: How long is a half marathon?
faqs.answer: A half marathon covers 21.1 kilometers (13.1 miles), exactly half the distance of a full marathon. It's a common step-up distance for runners who have completed 10K races and want a longer challenge without yet committing to the training volume a full marathon typically requires.
